# Salehin Sajid

> Salehin Sajid (also written Sajid Salehin or Salihin Sajid) is a motion designer and 3D artist from Dhaka, Bangladesh. He makes explainer videos, UI animation, 3D visuals and video edits for SaaS, fintech and tech brands, working with clients worldwide.

## About
- Role: Motion designer & 3D artist, video editor
- Location: Dhaka, Bangladesh (works remotely worldwide)
- Education: B.Sc in Multimedia & Creative Technology, Daffodil International University
- Experience: Senior Video & Motion Designer at Sapphire Lead (2025); Video & Motion Designer at DIU Campus TV (2025–26); freelancing since 2020
- Recognition: 6th of 39 in the 3D Religious Monument Exhibition; Bangladesh Bank Bangla QR reel competition entry
- Tools: After Effects, Premiere Pro, Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, Maya, 3ds Max, Arnold
- Services: SaaS & product explainers, UI & app animation, 3D product & space visuals, talking-head editing

## Selected work
- Valopay: fintech app launch video (UI animation, 3D camera)
- bKash: Bangla-language app feature promo
- Bangla QR: fintech reel for Bangladesh Bank's competition
- Google Gemini, Google Drive, PixelForge AI: concept product films
